question: In 2012 , for which of the following films did Pandit Birju Maharaj win the 'Best Choreography' category National Award?
solution:
The correct answer is Vishwaroopam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**__**Pandit Birju Maharaj:**__

__
 
• He was one of** India's most famous and favourite artists **and belonged to the** Kalka-Bindadin Gharana of Lucknow**, a classical Kathak dance form.
 
• Awarded **Padma Vibhushan in 1986**, Birju Maharaj also** choreographed dance in several Bollywood films**, including Umrao Jaan, Dedh Ishqiya, and Bajirao Mastani.
 
• Apart from Padma Vibhushan, he has also received **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award and Kalidas Samman**.
 
• In 2012, he was awarded the** National Film Award for choreography in the film Vishwaroopam**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**__**Brij Mohan Nath Mishra:**__

 
• He is popularly known as **Pandit Birju Maharaj.**
 
• He was born on February 4, 1938, in Lucknow. 
 
• The world famous Kathak dancer Pandit Birju Maharaj was the** face of the Kalka-Bindadin gharana of Lucknow.**
 
• The Lucknow Gharana was established under the** patronage of Wajid Ali Shah, the last Nawab of Oudh.** 
 
• It puts a **strong accent on Bhava**, the expression of moods and emotions.
 
• The other name of 'Lucknow Gharana - a style of dance and music is Purab Gharana.
 
• In Hindustani music, a Gharana is a **system of social organization **in the Indian subcontinent, linking music or dancers by lineage or apprenticeship and by adherence to a particular musical style.
 
• Lucknow Gharana or Purab Gharana is one of the **six main Gharanas or styles in Tabla.**
